description: Land Title Settlement Department - Warapalana, Mahara D/S Division, Gampaha District - Cad. Map No. 510805
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act, No. 21 of 1998. It contains declarations of determination by the Commissioner of Title Settlement regarding specific land parcels, including parcel numbers, cadastral map references, locations, and ownership details. The content focuses entirely on land registration, title determinations, and property ownership matters, which falls squarely under the Land Gazettes classification (Type 4).
